ground_truth_metrics_and_values_for_pred.value: COMET leverages cross-lingual similarities primarily using transfer learning, cross-lingual pretraining, and multi-source supervision to enhance Machine Translation for low-resource languages such as Hausa. By aligning multilingual sentence representations and sharing parameters across related and high-resource languages, COMET improves the quality of MT for Hausa through: (1) exploiting shared lexical and syntactic features, (2) using cross-lingual evaluation metrics (like chrF++, BLEU, and COMET itself) for model selection and training, and (3) facilitating transfer from typologically similar African and Indo-European languages. This leads to substantial improvements in translation accuracy and robustness, especially where parallel Hausa data is limited.
